commit_message:
ci: install ripgrep before unchanged tripotent quality gates

The Theory Audit shell checks emitted command-not-found errors while the
wrapper returned success. Install and verify ripgrep in the disposable runner
before executing the existing source and root gates. No proof source, gate,
threshold or Lean/Mathlib pin is changed.

changed_files.patch:
@@ -93,6 +93,9 @@ jobs:
         shell: bash
         run: |
           set -euo pipefail
+          sudo apt-get update
+          sudo apt-get install --yes ripgrep
+          rg --version
           python3 -m venv qa-env
           qa-env/bin/pip install jsonschema==4.23.0
           echo "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/qa-env/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

proof_source_equivalence: All 58 repository source modules, target list, checkers, Lean/Mathlib pins and gate scripts are unchanged by the complete one-file diff.
workflow_difference: Three prerequisite-installation lines in the source-gates job; kernel-check job unchanged.
acceptance_limit: This is a source-equivalence observation; it is not a kernel or root-gate acceptance for the new tree.
